title: Transducer Placement and the Limits of a Four-State Reduced Model in Post-Flutter Piezoelectric Energy Harvesting from a Pitch-Plunge-Flap Aerofoil
summary: Aeroelastic ?utter is normally a failure mode to be designed against, yet the limit-cycle oscillations (LCOs) that follow it convert flow energy into sustained structural motion that a piezoelectric transducer can turn into electrical power.
